details.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
details.descriptionEn:
The Old Mountain Dragon Lao-
Shan Lung seems to be invading
the ≪Fortress≫, the gateway to
Dondruma! Make full use of the
fortress's intercept devices and
repel Lao-Shan Lung! Those
lacking strength should ride on
its back, obtain ≪Dragonite Ore≫
and put it in the delivery box!
details.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマへの玄関口となる
≪砦≫に老山龍ラオシャンロ
ンが侵攻してきたようじゃ！
砦の迎撃設備を最大限に活用
し老山龍を撃退するのじゃ！
戦力の及ばぬ者は老山龍の背
に乗り≪龍薬石≫を入手して
納品ＢＯＸに納めるのじゃ！
